title: Water board gives sewage-treated water free; you pay only transport

slides.head: Water board gives sewage-treated water free; you pay only transport
What happened
slides.body: Builders, commercial buildings and apartment associations can register their own tankers or book through the water board.

slides.head: Why it matters
slides.body: To cut use of drinking water and pressure on groundwater for construction and gardening.

slides.head: helpline to book
slides.body: The board's target: save at least 20% of the city's drinking water through such switches.

slides.head: Dig deeper
slides.body: Each green tanker carries 30,000-40,000 litres, with 3-4 trips a day for one developer.

slides.head: What to watch
slides.body: How many builders and apartments sign up as summer approaches. Ask: Should large gated communities be required to use treated water?

slides.head: Spill the tea, daily
slides.body: Hyderabad news in 30 seconds, with the numbers and the questions. Follow for tomorrow's drop: spillthetea.news

captions.instagram:
Water board gives sewage-treated water free; you pay only transport

HMWSSB's Dial-a-Green Tanker scheme supplies treated water from sewage treatment plants at no cost for non-drinking uses; users pay only transport.

Why it matters: To cut use of drinking water and pressure on groundwater for construction and gardening.

Source: Times of India. Image: Times of India
